name: Heritage Tomato & Burrata
serving_size: Designed for one guest to share or enjoy as a light starter
short_description: Ripe heritage tomatoes, creamy burrata, basil oil and toasted sourdough.
description: A bright, summery opening dish built around ripe heritage tomatoes in varied colours and textures. A soft ball of burrata is opened at the table or just before serving, allowing its creamy centre to mingle with the tomato juices. Basil oil adds a fresh herbal aroma, while a light sherry-vinegar dressing gives the plate a gentle tang. Finished with cracked black pepper, flaky sea salt and crisp sourdough for scooping up the dressing.
dietary_tags: vegetarian
chef_notes: Best served at room temperature so the tomatoes retain their fragrance.

name: Whipped Goat’s Cheese & Heritage Beetroot
short_description: Silky goat’s cheese, roasted beetroot, orange, hazelnut crumb and garden leaves.
description: Earthy beetroot is slowly roasted until tender, then cut into jewel-like wedges and dressed with orange zest and a little citrus juice. A whipped goat’s cheese cream provides a tangy, cloud-soft contrast. Toasted hazelnut crumb adds warmth and crunch, while tender garden leaves bring a fresh finish. The overall flavour moves from sweet and earthy to creamy, nutty and lightly citrusy, without becoming heavy.
dietary_tags: vegetarian
gluten-free by listed ingredients
chef_notes: Keep the hazelnut crumb separate until plating to preserve its crunch.

name: Wild Mushroom & Parmesan Arancini
short_description: Golden risotto croquettes with wild mushrooms, Parmesan and truffle aioli.
description: Creamy risotto is folded with finely chopped wild mushrooms, herbs and aged Parmesan, shaped into small rounds, coated in breadcrumbs and fried until the outside is delicately crisp. The centre stays soft and savoury, with mushroom depth balanced by the salty nuttiness of the cheese. A small spoon of truffle aioli provides an earthy aroma; baby herbs and lemon zest keep the finish lively.
dietary_tags: vegetarian
chef_notes: Serve immediately after frying; the contrast between crisp shell and creamy centre is essential.

name: Seared Scallops, Cauliflower Purée & Caper Butter
short_description: Sweet scallops, smooth cauliflower purée, browned butter and crisp capers.
description: Plump scallops are seared briefly over high heat to create a golden surface while keeping the centre tender. They sit on a velvety cauliflower purée with a mild, gently sweet flavour. Browned butter brings toasted, nutty notes, while capers add a sharp saline lift that cuts through the richness. A few micro herbs and a fine squeeze of lemon complete this restrained, restaurant-style seafood plate.
dietary_tags: gluten-free by listed ingredients
chef_notes: Scallops are best cooked to order; do not hold them under heat for long.

name: Chicken Liver Parfait & Fig Chutney
serving_size: Parfait for sharing with toasted brioche
short_description: Smooth chicken liver parfait, fig chutney, pickled shallot and brioche.
description: A classic French-inspired starter with a silky, spreadable chicken liver parfait, carefully seasoned for a rounded savoury flavour. Fig chutney contributes deep fruit sweetness and a gentle acidity, while pickled shallot adds a crisp, tangy counterpoint. Thick slices of toasted brioche offer a buttery, lightly sweet base. The dish is rich, so the chutney and pickled shallot are intentionally generous enough to balance each bite.
chef_notes: Serve chilled but not refrigerator-hard; allow a short tempering period before service.

name: Crispy Calamari & Lemon Aioli
serving_size: A sharing bowl for two or a generous starter
short_description: Lightly crisp squid, lemon aioli, parsley and a bright herb salad.
description: Tender squid rings and small tentacles are lightly coated in seasoned flour and fried until crisp rather than heavy. The coating is designed to stay delicate, allowing the squid’s mild sweetness to come through. Lemon aioli adds a creamy citrus note, while parsley, lemon zest and a few finely sliced pickled onions bring freshness. Served hot with lemon wedges for a clean, lively finish.
chef_notes: Drain thoroughly and season as soon as the squid leaves the fryer.

name: Slow-Cooked French Onion Soup
short_description: Deeply caramelised onions, thyme broth, toasted baguette and melted Gruyère.
description: Onions are cooked slowly until sweet, golden and deeply savoury, then simmered with thyme and a rich vegetable-based broth. The soup is served in a crock with toasted baguette and Gruyère melted over the top. Each spoonful combines sweet onion, aromatic herbs, savoury stock and a little cheese richness. It is a comforting classic with a long, rounded finish rather than a sharp onion bite.
dietary_tags: vegetarian if stock is verified vegetarian
chef_notes: For the demo recipe, label the stock source explicitly before publishing dietary claims.

name: Smoked Salmon Rillette & Cucumber Pickle
short_description: Flaked smoked salmon, crème fraîche, dill, lemon and crisp rye.
description: Smoked salmon is gently flaked and folded with crème fraîche, lemon zest, dill and finely chopped shallot to create a soft, spoonable rillette. The texture remains intentionally rustic, with visible flakes of fish rather than a smooth mousse. Quick-pickled cucumber adds a cool, refreshing crunch, while rye crisps contribute a toasted, earthy note. The result is creamy and smoky but lifted by citrus and herbs.
chef_notes: Keep chilled and add the cucumber pickle just before serving.

name: Hand-Cut Beef Tartare
short_description: Hand-cut beef, Dijon mustard, capers, shallot, cornichons and egg yolk.
description: Finely diced beef is seasoned to order with Dijon mustard, capers, shallot, cornichons and a restrained touch of Worcestershire-style seasoning. The texture is deliberately hand-cut so the beef remains distinct rather than minced into a paste. A glossy egg yolk adds richness, while toasted sourdough provides crunch. This is a bold, savoury starter designed for guests who enjoy a classic raw-beef preparation.

allergens.name: Fish (possible in Worcestershire-style sauce; verify brand)

chef_notes: Fictional demo item; a real service would require strict sourcing, cold-chain and food-safety controls.

name: Butternut Squash & Sage Ravioli
short_description: Fresh pasta parcels, roasted squash, brown butter, sage and toasted pumpkin seeds.
description: Fresh pasta parcels are filled with roasted butternut squash, a little ricotta and nutmeg. They are dressed in nutty brown butter infused with crisp sage leaves, then finished with toasted pumpkin seeds and a fine snowfall of hard cheese. The squash brings natural sweetness, the sage adds an aromatic savoury edge and the pumpkin seeds provide a gentle crunch. A small amount of lemon zest keeps the butter from feeling too rich.
dietary_tags: vegetarian
chef_notes: Finish with brown butter only after the ravioli are drained so the sauce clings evenly.

name: Roast Chicken Supreme
short_description: Herb-roasted chicken breast, fondant potato, glazed carrots and thyme jus.
description: Chicken supreme is roasted until the skin is golden and crisp while the meat stays succulent. It is served with a fondant potato browned in butter, glazed seasonal carrots and a thyme-scented jus made from roasted aromatics. The sauce is glossy and savoury, designed to complement the chicken rather than overwhelm it. Fresh parsley and a touch of lemon brighten the final plate.
dietary_tags: gluten-free by listed ingredients; verify stock
chef_notes: Use a verified stock specification before making allergen or dietary promises.

name: Dry-Aged Beef Fillet, Peppercorn Sauce
serving_size: One main course; steak weight shown on final menu
short_description: Beef fillet, crushed potatoes, charred tenderstem broccoli and creamy peppercorn sauce.
description: A tender beef fillet is seared for a deeply browned crust and finished to the guest’s requested doneness where operationally supported. Crushed potatoes are roasted with herbs until crisp at the edges and soft in the centre. Charred tenderstem broccoli brings a green, lightly smoky contrast. The peppercorn sauce is creamy and gently warming, with cracked pepper providing a lingering savoury heat rather than overwhelming the beef.
dietary_tags: gluten-free by listed ingredients; verify stock
chef_notes: In a real menu, specify steak weight and doneness options clearly.

name: Pan-Roasted Sea Bass, Fennel & Lemon Beurre Blanc
short_description: Crisp-skinned sea bass, braised fennel, crushed new potatoes and lemon butter sauce.
description: Sea bass is cooked skin-side down to achieve a thin, crisp skin and a moist, delicate flesh. Braised fennel softens into a gentle aniseed sweetness, while crushed new potatoes soak up the lemon beurre blanc. The sauce is buttery and bright, balancing richness with citrus acidity. Dill fronds and finely grated lemon zest add a fresh aromatic finish to this elegant coastal-inspired plate.
dietary_tags: gluten-free by listed ingredients
chef_notes: Check fish bones carefully and keep the skin crisp until service.

name: Wild Mushroom Wellington
short_description: Mushroom duxelles wrapped in golden puff pastry with red wine-style jus and greens.
description: A savoury mixture of finely chopped wild mushrooms, shallots, thyme and chestnuts is cooked down until concentrated and wrapped in flaky puff pastry. The pastry bakes to a deep golden colour, creating a crisp shell around the rich, earthy filling. Served with seasonal greens and a glossy vegetarian jus, the dish offers a satisfying centrepiece with layers of buttery pastry, woodland aroma and gentle herbal notes.
dietary_tags: vegetarian
chef_notes: Keep the filling dry and cool before wrapping to avoid soggy pastry.

name: Slow-Braised Lamb Shoulder
short_description: Fork-tender lamb, rosemary potato purée, glazed shallots and red wine jus.
description: Lamb shoulder is braised slowly with rosemary, garlic and aromatic vegetables until it becomes tender enough to separate easily with a fork. The cooking liquor is reduced into a deep, savoury jus with gentle wine notes. A smooth potato purée provides a buttery base, while glazed shallots contribute sweetness and a little texture. Rosemary is used carefully so its pine-like aroma supports the lamb without dominating it.
dietary_tags: gluten-free by listed ingredients; verify stock
chef_notes: Braising liquid can be prepared ahead, but portioning and reheating require controlled food-safety procedures.

name: Crispy-Skin Salmon, Pea Purée & Dill Oil
short_description: Pan-seared salmon, sweet pea purée, buttered greens and fragrant dill oil.
description: A salmon fillet is seared skin-side down for a crisp finish, then cooked until the flesh is tender and moist. Sweet pea purée brings a fresh, garden-like sweetness, balanced by buttered greens and a vivid dill oil. A few pickled mustard seeds add tiny pops of acidity and texture. The plate is clean and seasonal, with the salmon’s natural richness supported by herbs rather than a heavy sauce.
dietary_tags: gluten-free by listed ingredients
chef_notes: Dry the skin thoroughly before searing to improve crispness.

name: Wild Boar Ragù Pappardelle
short_description: Wide ribbons of pasta, slow-cooked boar ragù, tomato, red wine and Parmesan.
description: Wide pappardelle ribbons are coated in a slow-cooked ragù made with wild boar, tomato, onion, carrot, herbs and a splash of red wine. Long cooking develops a deep, rounded flavour and a sauce that clings to the pasta. Parmesan adds salty nuttiness, while parsley and a little orange zest lift the finish. This is a rustic, hearty dish inspired by northern Italian cooking.
chef_notes: The ragù should be thick enough to coat the pasta without pooling at the bottom of the bowl.

name: Wild Mushroom Risotto, Aged Parmesan
short_description: Creamy Arborio rice, sautéed woodland mushrooms, Parmesan and chive oil.
description: Arborio rice is cooked gradually with hot stock until the grains are tender with a slight bite and the texture becomes naturally creamy. Sautéed woodland mushrooms add an earthy, savoury depth, while aged Parmesan enriches the finish. Chive oil brings a fresh green note and a few crisp mushroom slices provide texture. The risotto is served loose and glossy, not stiff or moulded into a mound.
dietary_tags: vegetarian if stock is verified vegetarian
gluten-free by listed ingredients; verify stock
chef_notes: Finish to order with stock and butter for a flowing texture.

name: Seared Duck Breast, Cherry Jus & Parsnip
short_description: Pink-centred duck breast, silky parsnip purée, seasonal greens and cherry jus.
description: Duck breast is rendered slowly skin-side down before being finished to the kitchen’s food-safety and service standards. The skin is crisp, the meat rich, and a cherry jus brings a tart-sweet fruit note that works naturally with duck. Parsnip purée offers a mellow sweetness, while bitter greens keep the dish balanced. The finish is elegant and savoury, with the fruit sauce used as an accent rather than a sugary glaze.
dietary_tags: gluten-free by listed ingredients; verify stock
chef_notes: The demo description avoids promising a particular internal temperature or doneness without a defined kitchen process.

name: Roasted Cauliflower Steak, Romesco & Crispy Chickpeas
short_description: Caramelised cauliflower, smoky pepper romesco, chickpeas and herb salad.
description: A thick cauliflower slice is roasted until its edges caramelise and the centre becomes tender. It is paired with romesco, a smoky Spanish-inspired sauce made from roasted peppers, tomato and almonds, plus crisp chickpeas for protein and crunch. A bright herb salad and lemon dressing cut through the roasted flavours. The plate is colourful and substantial, designed as a plant-based main rather than a side dish.
dietary_tags: vegan by listed ingredients; verify all supplier products
gluten-free by listed ingredients
chef_notes: For a vegan claim, verify every purchased sauce and ingredient and prevent cross-contact.

name: Slow-Roasted Pork Belly, Apple Purée & Cider Jus
short_description: Tender pork belly with crisp crackling, apple purée, braised cabbage and cider jus.
description: Pork belly is slow-roasted to soften the meat, then finished to create a crisp, golden top. A smooth apple purée adds a fresh sweetness, while braised red cabbage brings gentle acidity and colour. The cider jus ties the plate together with savoury depth and a subtle orchard aroma. Pickled apple slices add a crisp finish that keeps the richness of the pork in balance.

allergens.name: Milk
allergens.status: contains if butter is used; confirm recipe
allergens.notes: Recipe specification should control the final declaration

chef_notes: Store a separate recipe version if the butter or stock formulation changes.

name: Lemon & Thyme Roast Cod
short_description: Flaky cod, crushed peas, buttered leeks, new potatoes and lemon-thyme oil.
description: A thick cod loin is roasted gently until the flakes separate cleanly and remain moist. Crushed peas and mint provide a sweet, fresh base, while buttered leeks bring a soft allium flavour. New potatoes add substance without making the plate heavy. Lemon-thyme oil contributes citrus and herbal fragrance, giving the dish a clean finish suited to a seasonal modern-European menu.
dietary_tags: gluten-free by listed ingredients
chef_notes: Check the cod carefully for bones and keep the garnish light.

name: Truffle Macaroni & Three-Cheese Crust
short_description: Macaroni in a mature-cheddar sauce with Gruyère, Parmesan and a crisp crumb.
description: Macaroni is coated in a smooth sauce made from mature Cheddar, Gruyère and Parmesan, then baked beneath a golden, lightly crisp breadcrumb crust. A small amount of truffle oil adds an earthy aroma without masking the cheeses. Chives and black pepper finish the dish with freshness and gentle warmth. It is deliberately indulgent and can be paired with a green salad for contrast.
dietary_tags: vegetarian if cheese rennet is verified
chef_notes: The demo menu can offer a side salad as an optional extra rather than changing the base dish.

name: Herb-Crusted Lamb Rump
short_description: Rosemary-herb crusted lamb, butter beans, grilled courgette and mint jus.
description: Lamb rump is seared and finished with a fragrant crust of rosemary, parsley and breadcrumbs. Creamy butter beans provide a soft, comforting base, while grilled courgette brings a lightly smoky vegetable note. A mint jus gives the plate a fresh herbal lift without turning it sweet. The combination feels classic and hearty, with varied textures from the crust, beans and charred vegetables.
chef_notes: Keep the herb crust crisp and apply it near the end of cooking.

name: Madagascan Vanilla Crème Brûlée
short_description: Vanilla custard beneath a thin, glassy caramelised sugar crust.
description: A rich baked custard is infused with vanilla and chilled until delicately set. Just before serving, a thin layer of sugar is caramelised to form a crisp shell that cracks under the spoon. The contrast between cool, silky custard and warm, brittle caramel is the point of the dessert. A few seasonal berries may be added for acidity, but the vanilla remains the main flavour.
dietary_tags: vegetarian
chef_notes: Caramelise the sugar shortly before the dish leaves the kitchen.

name: Dark Chocolate Délice, Sea Salt & Crème Fraîche
short_description: Dense dark chocolate crémeux, cocoa crumb, crème fraîche and sea salt.
description: A smooth dark chocolate crémeux is set to a soft, truffle-like texture and served with a fine cocoa crumb for contrast. Crème fraîche brings a cool tang that cuts through the chocolate’s intensity, while a few crystals of sea salt make the cocoa flavour feel deeper and longer-lasting. The dessert is rich rather than oversized, intended for slow enjoyment after a multi-course meal.
dietary_tags: vegetarian
chef_notes: Use the chocolate supplier specification to confirm any soy or other allergen declaration.

name: Sticky Toffee Pudding & Butterscotch Sauce
short_description: Date sponge, warm butterscotch sauce and vanilla ice cream.
description: A soft sponge made with dates is served warm and covered with a glossy butterscotch sauce. The dates give the pudding a deep caramel-like sweetness and a moist crumb, while vanilla ice cream melts into the sauce to create a creamy contrast. A small pinch of sea salt helps balance the sweetness. This is a comforting British classic with a generous sauce rather than a delicate, dry cake.
dietary_tags: vegetarian
chef_notes: Warm the pudding through evenly and add sauce immediately before service.

name: Lemon Posset, Raspberry & Shortbread
short_description: Silky lemon cream, raspberry compote and buttery shortbread crumb.
description: A chilled lemon posset has a smooth, delicate set and a bright citrus flavour that feels refreshing after a rich main course. Raspberry compote adds tart fruit notes and a natural red colour, while shortbread crumb provides a buttery, sandy crunch. The layers are served in a glass or shallow bowl so the pale cream, ruby fruit and golden crumb remain visually distinct.
dietary_tags: vegetarian
chef_notes: Keep the shortbread crumb separate until service to preserve its texture.

name: Poached Pear & Almond Frangipane Tart
short_description: Buttery pastry, almond frangipane, poached pear and vanilla cream.
description: A crisp pastry shell holds a soft almond frangipane filling, topped with pear poached in a lightly spiced syrup. The pear remains tender and fragrant, while the almond filling provides a moist, nutty centre. Served with a spoon of vanilla cream, the tart balances fruit freshness with buttery pastry. A little lemon zest keeps the flavour from becoming overly sweet.
dietary_tags: vegetarian
chef_notes: Display the almond allergen prominently on both card and dish detail.

name: Seasonal British Cheese Board
serving_size: A board for one or two guests
short_description: A rotating selection of British cheeses, chutney, grapes, oatcakes and fruit.
description: A small selection of British cheeses is served at a cool room temperature to bring out their aroma and texture. The board may include a creamy soft cheese, a firm aged cheese and a blue cheese, paired with seasonal chutney, grapes, dried fruit and oatcakes. The flavour moves from buttery and mild to savoury and more assertive. The exact cheese selection should be updated in the live menu as stock changes.

allergens.name: Sulphites
allergens.status: verify chutney and dried fruit specification

dietary_tags: vegetarian only if cheese rennet is verified
chef_notes: This is a rotating item; store actual cheese names and supplier allergen sheets in the live system.

name: Elderflower Panna Cotta, Strawberries & Mint
short_description: Delicate elderflower cream, macerated strawberries and fresh mint.
description: A softly set panna cotta is infused with elderflower for a light floral aroma. Strawberries are gently macerated to draw out their juice, creating a bright red sauce that complements the cream. Fresh mint and a little lemon zest provide a clean finish. The dessert is intentionally delicate and not overly sweet, with a smooth texture and a clear contrast between floral cream and fresh fruit.
dietary_tags: not vegetarian if animal-derived gelatine is used
chef_notes: For a vegetarian version, use a verified suitable setting agent and update the ingredient record.

name: Espresso & Chocolate Affogato
short_description: Vanilla ice cream, freshly pulled espresso and dark chocolate shavings.
description: A scoop of vanilla ice cream is served with a freshly pulled shot of espresso poured at the table or just before serving. The hot coffee melts the edges of the ice cream into a bittersweet, creamy sauce. Dark chocolate shavings add a gentle snap and deeper cocoa flavour. It is a simple, theatrical finish for guests who prefer coffee-led desserts over very sweet pastries.
dietary_tags: vegetarian if supplier ingredients are verified
chef_notes: This is a non-alcoholic dessert despite the espresso-martini-inspired naming being deliberately avoided here.

name: House-Made Lemon & Thyme Lemonade
short_description: Fresh lemon, thyme syrup, chilled sparkling water and a citrus garnish.
description: Fresh lemon juice is balanced with a lightly sweet thyme syrup, then lengthened with chilled sparkling water. The thyme contributes a subtle herbal fragrance without making the drink taste savoury. Served over ice with a lemon wheel, it is crisp, refreshing and suitable as a bright non-alcoholic pairing for seafood, salads or rich mains.
dietary_tags: vegan by listed ingredients
chef_notes: Prepare syrup in small batches and record preparation date in a real kitchen.

name: Rhubarb & Ginger Spritz
short_description: Rhubarb cordial, ginger, lime and sparkling water over ice.
description: Tart rhubarb cordial gives the drink a delicate pink colour and a sharp, fruity opening. Fresh lime adds brightness, while ginger provides a warming note at the back of the palate. Sparkling water keeps the drink light and lively. It is designed as an alcohol-free aperitif with enough acidity and complexity to feel considered rather than like a simple soft drink.
dietary_tags: vegan if supplier products are verified
chef_notes: Label this explicitly as alcohol-free in the demo menu; verify all cordial ingredients.

name: Single-Origin Filter Coffee
short_description: Freshly brewed filter coffee with a balanced, chocolate-and-citrus profile.
description: A rotating single-origin coffee is brewed to highlight a balanced profile, described in this demo as cocoa, toasted nuts and a gentle citrus finish. It is served black, with milk or a plant-based alternative available as an optional addition. The origin and tasting notes should be updated whenever the coffee supplier changes so the menu remains accurate.

name: Loose-Leaf English Breakfast Tea
short_description: A robust black tea served with lemon or milk on request.
description: A full-bodied black tea is brewed in a small pot and served with a timer-free, straightforward presentation: a cup, strainer and optional lemon or milk. The flavour is malty and brisk, pairing well with desserts and after-dinner conversation. The base drink contains tea and water; any optional additions are recorded separately for accurate order and allergen handling.

name: Seasonal Berry Fizz
short_description: Crushed seasonal berries, lemon, mint and sparkling water.
description: Seasonal berries are lightly crushed to release their juice, then mixed with lemon and sparkling water. Mint adds a cool, aromatic finish while the fruit provides natural tartness and colour. The drink is refreshing and not intended to be syrupy; sweetness can be adjusted as a selectable preference in the demo ordering flow.

chef_notes: If a berry syrup is used, store its full ingredient and allergen specification.

name: Velvet Dark Hot Chocolate
short_description: Dark chocolate melted into steamed milk, finished with cocoa dust.
description: Dark chocolate is melted into steamed milk to create a smooth, full-bodied drink with a deep cocoa aroma. The sweetness is restrained so the chocolate remains the focus. A light cocoa dusting adds fragrance on top. Guests can request a plant-based milk option, but the actual allergen information must follow the chosen milk and chocolate product specifications.

name: Autumn Pumpkin Soup, Sage Oil & Seeds
short_description: Roasted pumpkin soup, sage oil, toasted pumpkin seeds and sourdough.
description: Pumpkin is roasted to concentrate its sweetness before being blended with vegetable stock into a smooth, warming soup. Sage oil adds a fragrant, savoury note, while toasted pumpkin seeds provide a crisp finish. A small swirl of cream may be used in the standard demo recipe, with sourdough served on the side. The flavour is autumnal and mellow, with black pepper and a touch of nutmeg for depth.
dietary_tags: vegetarian if stock is verified vegetarian
chef_notes: For a dairy-free variation, create a separate recipe record and re-verify every ingredient.

name: Winter Root Vegetable Crumble
short_description: Roasted root vegetables, thyme gravy and a crisp savoury oat topping.
description: Carrots, parsnips and celeriac are roasted until their edges caramelise, then placed in a shallow dish with a rich thyme gravy. A savoury crumble topping made with oats, flour and butter bakes to a crisp golden layer. The dish offers sweet roasted vegetables, herbal gravy and a crunchy top, making it a warming seasonal vegetarian main. A side of greens adds freshness and colour.
dietary_tags: vegetarian if stock is verified vegetarian
chef_notes: The allergen declaration should list celeriac clearly; do not hide it under generic root vegetables.

name: Seared Venison Saddle, Blackberry Jus & Celeriac
short_description: Lean venison, celeriac purée, roasted beetroot and blackberry jus.
description: Venison saddle is seared to develop a savoury crust and paired with a smooth celeriac purée. Roasted beetroot adds earthy sweetness, while blackberry jus brings a tart, dark-fruit note that complements the lean meat. Juniper and thyme contribute woodland aromatics in the background. The plate is rich in flavour but balanced by the fruit acidity and the clean texture of the purée.
dietary_tags: gluten-free by listed ingredients; verify stock
chef_notes: Seasonal availability and supplier traceability should be represented in the admin system.

name: Potato Gnocchi, Brown Butter & Crispy Sage
short_description: Soft potato gnocchi, nutty brown butter, sage, roasted squash and Parmesan.
description: Pillowy potato gnocchi are pan-finished in brown butter until their edges pick up a light golden colour. Roasted squash adds sweetness, crisp sage contributes an aromatic crunch, and Parmesan brings a salty, savoury finish. A little lemon zest keeps the butter bright. The dish is simple in appearance but depends on a careful balance of tender gnocchi, nutty sauce and crisp garnish.
dietary_tags: vegetarian if cheese rennet is verified
chef_notes: Gnocchi can be made in advance, but should be finished in the pan close to service.
